description: A canned transcript with no PII in any class the substrate covers. Used to pin that the redactor does not fire on ordinary speech — a redactor that never has a false positive on a call like this is the other half of being useful.

segments.text: Right, shall we start with the roadmap review, we have about twenty minutes.
Yes, I have to go for the numbers first, we shipped two releases this quarter.
The second one was late but nothing broke, so I'd call that a reasonable trade.
Agreed. In 2026 we expect 1500 units, which is up on the 900 we did last year.
One two three, testing the audio again, sorry, the room mic keeps dropping out.
No problem. Let's pick this up on Thursday and close out the actions then.
